design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not analyze cognitive achievement plausible values as it focuses on process data and self-reported effort.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not use multilevel modeling or account for school clustering in its analysis of individual student data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.
